The official release article is dated 9 August 2022 and reports that the six errata were included in the PDF publicly released that day. Its exact linked PDF is the combined Set 19 and errata source, whose Thrawn partial matches the standalone August errata in native RGB and original mask. The separately mentioned 15 August date is for GEMP, not the PDF release.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-beautiful-and-thematic-virtual-set-19-has-arrived/ Official Players Committee release article], 9 August 2022; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-19-Plus-Errata.pdf linked combined PDF], page 7. The actual live article date, body and PDF link were verified in a browser. The current PDF’s Thrawn RGB and mask match the standalone August edition; no independently preserved 2022 article or PDF bytes were verified.</ref>

|notes=* The lower-only slip omits the upper title, rarity, destiny and lore. Those displayed values, including uniqueness, are inherited from the identified original full face ([[:File:V7-D-grandadmiralthrawn-2018-07-08.gif]]) and underlying [[Grand Admiral Thrawn]]. The caption’s presence or absence of a dot describes its layout; it is not evidence of a gameplay uniqueness change.
* [Pilot] represents the printed pilot icon, followed by the literal numeral 3. It is not an additional sentence printed on the face.
* The retained relationship lists are supported by the pinned contemporary Dark metadata and the named cards’ actual faces in the official repository copy dated 11 August 2022. Applying the 2023 Advanced Rulebook, Blizzard 4 can deploy this Imperial warrior; Imperial Command can take this admiral into hand; Endor Shield (V) prints ▲ for an Imperial admiral; and the unique Chimaera’s reference to Thrawn forms a matching pair with this unique pilot. These are explicitly 2023-rule explanations, not a claim that every external rule was identical or first effective in August 2022.<ref name="thrawn-relationship-scope">[[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], pages 99 (▲), 100 (matching pairs) and 178 (characteristics). Actual official relationship-card faces in repository commit 25528d7: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/ReflectionsIII-Dark/large/blizzard4.gif Blizzard 4], [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/DeathStarII-Dark/large/imperialcommand.gif Imperial Command], [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/endorshield.gif Endor Shield (V)], [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/DeathStarII-Dark/large/chimaera.gif Chimaera].
